title: Borough Ruleset source manifest
description: The entry file of a source v1 package. It holds [source] and nothing else: declarations live in the members it lists. Unlike rulesets/ruleset.schema.json this one is hand-written and closed, because the surface is two keys and RulesetCapture.ReadManifest accepts no others -- there is no larger set it could be an incomplete view of. RulesetManifestSchemaTests drives every key here through the resolver and fails when the two disagree.

source.description: Declares the file a package is assembled from. A Ruleset holding this table is read as a manifest and may hold no other table.

version.description: States which source format the package is written in. This build reads version 1, and any other number is refused rather than guessed at, so an older reader meeting a newer package says so instead of misreading it.

members.description: Lists every file the package is assembled from, as quoted paths relative to this manifest. Nothing is found by scanning: a file not listed here is not part of the package. Paths go downward only and use forward slashes, the manifest may not list itself, and a path listed twice is refused. Order sets the order declarations are read in, which is what dense ids are allocated from.
